name: Dystonia Curated By Biia
description: Dystonia brings a hard techno night to Switch, curated by BIIA with VIL, CANCORD and LAVANE, on Friday 4 December from 23:00 to 06:00.
longDescription:
Dystonia, curated by BIIA, is a hard techno and techno night at Switch in Porto. The line-up features BIIA, VIL, CANCORD and LAVANE.

The party runs on Friday 4 December 2026 from 23:00 to 06:00 at Switch, Rua de Júlio Dinis 766. Doors open at 23:00 and last entry is at 05:00; if you leave you cannot re-enter.

Early bird general access tickets are €10.00 on Shotgun. Tickets are nominative and non-refundable, but can be resold in the Shotgun app.
